examples.en: We use a large language model for the draft, but a human reviews every case before it ships.
examples.zh: 我们用大语言模型起草，但每个用例上线前都有人审。

situation.en: The product is built on a large language model with retrieval on top.
situation.zh: 面试官问你们产品背后的技术，你先给一句话定义。

examples.en: The prompt tells the model the audience, the format, and two examples of the tone we want.
examples.zh: 提示词里写清了受众、格式，还给了两个想要的语气示例。

situation.en: Half the quality gain came from prompt engineering, not a bigger model.
situation.zh: 你分享经验：质量提升一半来自提示词工程。

examples.en: Retrieval-augmented generation means the model answers from our documents, not from memory.
examples.zh: 检索增强生成的意思是：模型根据我们的文档回答，而不是凭记忆。

situation.en: We chose RAG over fine-tuning because our docs change every week.
situation.zh: 被追问为什么不用微调时，你解释文档变得太勤。

examples.en: We chunk the documents into passages of about five hundred tokens before embedding them.
examples.zh: 我们先把文档切成大约五百个 token 一段，再做嵌入。

situation.en: Chunking strategy matters more than people expect in RAG quality.
situation.zh: 你指出切分策略对 RAG 质量的影响被低估了。

examples.en: Each passage is turned into an embedding and stored in a vector database.
examples.zh: 每段文本都被转成嵌入向量，存在向量数据库里。

situation.en: The embedding model choice affected recall more than the LLM did.
situation.zh: 你复盘发现嵌入模型对召回的影响更大。

examples.en: Semantic search finds passages by meaning, so synonyms stop being a problem.
examples.zh: 语义搜索按意思找段落，同义词不再是问题。

situation.en: We replaced keyword search with semantic search for the docs portal.
situation.zh: 你介绍文档门户的搜索升级。

examples.en: We rerank the top thirty results down to the best five before they reach the model.
examples.zh: 我们把前三十个结果重排，选出最好的五个再喂给模型。

situation.en: Adding a reranker bought us more quality than upgrading the model.
situation.zh: 你分享性价比最高的优化：加重排。

entries.zh: 重排（检索结果的二次排序）

examples.en: When the model invents an API that doesn't exist, that's a hallucination — grounding is how you fight it.
examples.zh: 模型编出一个不存在的接口，那就是幻觉；用检索锚定是治它的方法。

situation.en: Our hallucination rate dropped once answers had to cite sources.
situation.zh: 你介绍怎么把幻觉率降下来的。

examples.en: Every generated answer has to cite its sources, so reviewers can verify in seconds.
examples.zh: 每个生成的回答都必须引用出处，评审的人几秒就能核对。

situation.en: Citations turned the review from an hour into ten minutes.
situation.zh: 你讲引用出处怎么改变了评审效率。

entries.zh: 引用出处（生成的可信设计）

examples.en: Fine-tuning taught the model our format; retrieval teaches it our facts. We needed the facts.
examples.zh: 微调教模型我们的格式，检索教它我们的事实。我们缺的是事实。

entries.note: 这句对比是 RAG vs 微调的标准答法，能背下来面试直接用。

situation.en: Fine-tuning is the wrong tool when the knowledge changes weekly.
situation.zh: 你一句话说清为什么不用微调。

examples.en: The context window fits the top passages plus the conversation history — and nothing else.
examples.zh: 上下文窗口里放得下最相关的段落加上对话历史，不能再多了。

situation.en: Long documents overflow the context window, so we summarize in stages.
situation.zh: 你解释长文档怎么处理。

examples.en: Tokens are the unit you pay for — prompts, context, and output all count.
examples.zh: token 是你付费的单位，提示、上下文、输出全都算钱。

situation.en: Caching cut our token spend by about forty percent.
situation.zh: 你汇报成本优化的效果。

examples.en: Streaming the response token by token makes the product feel twice as fast.
examples.zh: 把回答一个 token 一个 token 地流式输出，产品感觉快了一倍。

situation.en: We stream responses so users see the first words in under a second.
situation.zh: 你介绍为什么要做流式输出。

examples.en: Temperature zero for extraction tasks, higher for brainstorming — randomness is a setting, not a surprise.
examples.zh: 抽取任务温度设零，头脑风暴调高：随机性是个设置，不是意外。

situation.en: For test generation we keep the temperature low for consistency.
situation.zh: 你解释生成测试用例时为什么压低温度。

entries.zh: 温度（控制随机性的参数）

examples.en: We built an evaluation set of two hundred golden cases before tuning anything.
examples.zh: 调任何参数之前，我们先建了一个两百条黄金用例的评估集。

situation.en: Every model change runs against the evaluation set first.
situation.zh: 你介绍模型变更的上线流程。

examples.en: Our golden dataset is hand-written by senior testers — it's the ground truth we trust.
examples.zh: 我们的黄金数据集是资深测试手写的，是我们信的那个标准答案。

situation.en: If it disagrees with the golden dataset, the model loses.
situation.zh: 你定评估的裁决规则。

examples.en: Precision went up, but recall dropped — we were missing edge cases we used to catch.
examples.zh: 精确率上去了，但召回率掉下来了，以前能抓到的边界情况现在漏了。

entries.note: precision / recall 的权衡是所有检索和分类系统的通用话题，不止 AI 面试。

situation.en: For test generation, recall matters more than precision.
situation.zh: 你论证为什么这个场景召回优先。

examples.en: Few-shot examples in the prompt fixed the output format better than any instruction paragraph.
examples.zh: 在提示里给几个例子，比写一大段说明更能固定输出格式。

situation.en: We went few-shot for the classification prompt — three examples.
situation.zh: 你介绍分类提示词的设计。

entries.zh: 少样本提示（给几个例子）

examples.en: Zero-shot worked for summaries, but anything with rules needed examples.
examples.zh: 零样本对摘要够用，但凡是带规则的任务都需要给例子。

situation.en: Zero-shot first; add examples only where it fails.
situation.zh: 你定提示词的迭代策略。

entries.zh: 零样本（不给例子直接问）

examples.en: Asking the model to reason step by step improved the tricky cases noticeably.
examples.zh: 让模型一步步推理，明显改善了棘手案例的表现。

situation.en: Chain-of-thought helped on the multi-hop questions.
situation.zh: 你介绍在多跳问题上有效的技巧。

examples.en: The agent calls tools in a loop: read the error, search the code, propose a patch.
examples.zh: 这个智能体循环地调用工具：读报错、搜代码、提补丁。

situation.en: Our agent is deliberately boring — three tools, hard limits, human approval.
situation.zh: 你介绍自家智能体的保守设计。

entries.zh: AI 智能体（能调用工具的）

examples.en: Tool calling lets the model fetch real data instead of guessing it.
examples.zh: 工具调用让模型去取真实数据，而不是猜。

situation.en: The model calls our search API as a tool when it needs fresh facts.
situation.zh: 你讲架构：模型怎么拿最新事实。

examples.en: Guardrails reject outputs that leak personal data before a human ever sees them.
examples.zh: 护栏会在人看到之前，拦下泄露个人信息的输出。

situation.en: Guardrails check every output for PII and banned content.
situation.zh: 你介绍输出安全层。

entries.zh: 护栏（AI 输出的安全约束）

examples.en: A human in the loop approves every generated test before it enters the suite.
examples.zh: 人在回路中：每个生成的用例进套件之前都要人批准。

situation.en: Full automation was faster, but human-in-the-loop earned the trust.
situation.zh: 你复盘为什么保留人工环节。

entries.zh: 人在回路（关键环节保留人工）

examples.en: Inference cost per request dropped once we cached the common prompts.
examples.zh: 把常见提示缓存之后，单次推理成本降下来了。

situation.en: At our volume, inference cost is the budget line that matters.
situation.zh: 你指出 AI 产品里真正的大头成本。

examples.en: Latency matters: users abandon a chat that thinks for ten seconds.
examples.zh: 延迟很关键，想十秒的聊天用户会直接关掉。

situation.en: We measure time to first token, not just total time.
situation.zh: 你介绍 AI 产品的延迟指标。

examples.en: The smaller model handles eighty percent of requests; the big one only sees the hard ones.
examples.zh: 小模型处理八成请求，大模型只看难题。

situation.en: Routing by difficulty cut our model bill in half.
situation.zh: 你介绍模型路由的成本策略。

examples.en: We log every prompt and completion for debugging — with personal data redacted.
examples.zh: 我们把每次提示和补全都记日志用于调试，个人信息已打码。

situation.en: Without prompt logs, AI bugs are impossible to reproduce.
situation.zh: 你论证为什么必须留提示日志。

examples.en: Model drift is real: the same prompt quietly gets worse over a quarter.
examples.zh: 模型漂移是真的：同一个提示一个季度后会悄悄变差。

situation.en: We rerun the evaluation set monthly to catch model drift.
situation.zh: 你介绍例行的模型体检。

entries.zh: 模型漂移（表现悄悄变差）

examples.en: The training data cutoff means the model can't know last month's API changes.
examples.zh: 训练数据的截止时间意味着，模型不可能知道上个月的接口变更。

situation.en: Retrieval fills the gap left by the training cutoff.
situation.zh: 你解释检索补的是哪块短板。

examples.en: Synthetic data filled the rare cases our real logs never showed.
examples.zh: 合成数据补上了真实日志里从没出现的稀有情况。

situation.en: We generated synthetic edge cases for the evaluation set.
situation.zh: 你介绍评估集怎么扩充边界情况。

examples.en: Benchmarks said the new model was better; our evaluation set said otherwise.
examples.zh: 公开跑分说新模型更好，我们的评估集可不这么说。

entries.note: 这句是面试里的好态度：不迷信跑分、信自己的评估。对爱问 AI 的面试官很对路。

situation.en: We trust our own evals over public benchmarks.
situation.zh: 你表态评估标准的选择。

examples.en: Vector similarity is fast but sloppy — it retrieves passages that mention the words, not the meaning you need.
examples.zh: 向量相似度快但糙，它捞回的是提到这些词的段落，不一定是你需要的含义。

situation.en: We combine vector similarity with keyword filters.
situation.zh: 你介绍混合检索的做法。

examples.en: Hybrid search — keywords plus vectors — beat either one alone on our data.
examples.zh: 混合搜索（关键词加向量）在我们的数据上胜过任何单一方法。

situation.en: Hybrid search is our default for anything user-facing.
situation.zh: 你介绍面向用户的搜索默认方案。

examples.en: The model's confidence is not a probability — never present it as one to users.
examples.zh: 模型的置信度不是概率，永远别那样展示给用户。

situation.en: We threshold on eval performance, not on the model's self-reported confidence.
situation.zh: 你解释为什么不信模型自报的把握。

examples.en: Prompt injection is the new SQL injection: user text tries to become instructions.
examples.zh: 提示注入是新时代的 SQL 注入：用户文本试图变成指令。

entries.note: 这个类比既准确又好记，安全和 AI 交叉的面试话题里非常出彩。

situation.en: We treat retrieved documents as data, never as instructions, to resist prompt injection.
situation.zh: 你介绍防提示注入的设计。

examples.en: We version prompts like code — every change is reviewed and tied to eval results.
examples.zh: 我们像管代码一样管理提示词版本，每次改动都要评审、挂钩评估结果。

situation.en: Prompts live in the repo, not in a spreadsheet.
situation.zh: 你介绍提示词的工程化管理。

examples.en: Distillation let a small model copy the big one's behavior on our narrow task.
examples.zh: 蒸馏让小模型在我们这个窄任务上学会了大模型的行为。

situation.en: After distillation, the small model matched quality at a tenth of the cost.
situation.zh: 你介绍蒸馏的收益。

examples.en: Multimodal input means the model can read the screenshot the user attached, not just the text.
examples.zh: 多模态输入意味着模型能看懂用户附的截图，不只是文字。

situation.en: Error screenshots go straight into the multimodal model for triage.
situation.zh: 你介绍多模态在分诊里的用法。

examples.en: The moat isn't the model — everyone rents the same models. The moat is your data and your evaluation loop.
examples.zh: 护城河不是模型，人人租的都是同样的模型。护城河是你的数据和你的评估闭环。

entries.note: 这是聊 AI 产品战略时非常有分量的一句，适合用在面试最后的产品讨论环节。

situation.en: Asked about defensibility, I'd say the moat is the data loop.
situation.zh: 面试官问产品壁垒，你给出你的判断。
